headline: 라쿤 야간 알바
솜사탕 사건

lines.say: 새벽 두 시. 라쿤의 편의점 야간 알바가 시작된다.
lines.img: a bright clean convenience store interior at night with a plain counter, behind the counter a plump raccoon with a black eye mask, soft grey fur and a bushy ringed tail wearing a plain green apron, plain white walls
close view of the bushy ringed tail of a plump raccoon with a black eye mask, soft grey fur and a bushy ringed tail swaying behind a plain store counter, plain white walls
a plump raccoon with a black eye mask, soft grey fur and a bushy ringed tail stocking plain colorful snack boxes on a bright store shelf at night, plain white walls

lines.say: 그때 손님이 솜사탕을 샀다. 그리고 물그릇에 담갔다.
lines.img: a plump raccoon with a black eye mask, soft grey fur and a bushy ringed tail standing at the counter dipping a fluffy pink cotton candy into a clear water bowl, the pink fluff dissolving in the water, bright store light

lines.say: 그날 밤 솜사탕은 하나도 안 팔렸다.
lines.img: a plump raccoon with a black eye mask, soft grey fur and a bushy ringed tail sitting behind a plain store counter looking at an empty paper cone and a bowl of pink water, calm quiet night light
